justification: User-facing truth defect (brief served 8-year refusal stats from a source frozen at 2023-04 as if current) but additive-only payload changes, fail-closed guards, no DB writes, no conveyancing PDF surface touched. Critical not needed: no new external source wired; Minor too low: changed user-visible statistical claims.

pre_impl.existing_data: DA tracking MapServer (frozen extract, newest lodgement 2023-04-29 verified live 2026-07-06); brief payloads da_outcomes/da_refusal_stats; golden fixtures captured 2026-07-04
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If the layer is refreshed or replaced, sentences stay correct automatically: the window is derived from the data (currency probe + row min/max), never hardcoded. If the layer disappears, the currency probe raises and the field renders NOT_AVAILABLE.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Payload fields are additive (radius_m/years_back kept); old payloads without window fields hit the frontend suppression path — temporal claim omitted, never defaulted.
pre_impl.external_source_error: ArcGIS returns HTTP 200 + error body; arcgis_get_with_retry maps that to {} and da_outcome.py raises on missing 'features'/'count' — never a silent zero.
pre_impl.frontend_type: DAOutcomesPayload/RefusalStatsRow extended with optional data_currency/window_start/window_end in components/reports/DAOutcomes.tsx (moved from page.tsx).
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: Currency probe failure -> field NOT_AVAILABLE with reason (visible gap row), not undated stats. Missing window fields -> 'Determination counts are not shown — the data window ... could not be established'.

functions.name: get_data_currency
functions.input: none (queries tracking layer, cached per process)
functions.output: YYYY-MM-DD newest lodgement -> RefusalStats.data_currency and brief payload
functions.if_none: raises RuntimeError on transport failure, zero rows, or unparseable value; failures are not cached

functions.name: get_refusal_rate
functions.input: lga name and years window from brief config (CONFIG.da_outcomes_years_back)
functions.if_none: currency probe failure raises before counts — stats without a stated window are never produced

functions.name: _fetch_da_outcomes
functions.input: lng/lat floats from the geocoded brief address
functions.output: payload dict with outcomes + data_currency + window_start/window_end (row-derived)
functions.if_none: raise -> _safe_call stamps NOT_AVAILABLE; empty rows -> window None + data_currency present

functions.name: formatMonthYear / lodgedWindowPhrase
functions.if_none: returns null/'' -> temporal phrase suppressed, never a fabricated date

functions.name: RefusalStatsSentence
functions.input: RefusalStatsRow payload object from the brief SSE stream
functions.output: windowed sentence or explicit suppression message
functions.if_none: missing window fields -> counts suppressed with stated reason (line 134)

values.if_missing: extent note omitted; refusal sentence replaced by suppression message

values.guard_at: lodgedWindowPhrase returns '' unless both ends parse
values.if_missing: no 'lodged between' phrase; counts still shown for the outcomes list (factual, no time claim)

queries.purpose: newest LODGEMENT_DATE on the tracking layer (currency probe)
queries.where_clause: LODGEMENT_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY LODGEMENT_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
queries.if_zero: raises RuntimeError ('no rows — cannot state a data window')
queries.if_wrong: unparseable value raises; lexicographic DESC on the layer's fixed-width string dates is order-correct (verified live)

break_it.scenario: Source goes stale AGAIN after a future re-wire (or stays frozen while users assume currency)
break_it.what_happens: Without the guard, stats render as current; with it, every sentence carries the data-derived window ('lodged between January 2018 and April 2023 (the extent of the published tracking data)')
break_it.how: services/da_outcome.py:161 currency probe + tests/test_brief_da_outcomes.py window assertions + jest golden tests pin the phrasing
break_it.repro: python -m pytest tests/test_brief_da_outcomes.py -k window; npx jest --testPathPattern=DAOutcomes

break_it.scenario: Currency probe fails while the counts succeed
break_it.what_happens: Stats without a window would render undated (the original defect)
break_it.how: services/da_outcome.py:307 probe runs before counts and raises; test_currency_failure_fails_the_stats_closed

break_it.scenario: Fractional-seconds lodgement dates ('20230429151817.89') pass through unparsed
break_it.what_happens: Window derivation drops rows / currency probe raises spuriously; 3 rows in the pre-fix golden fixture prove this happened in production captures

break_it.scenario: A payload without window fields reaches the frontend (stale cache, old generator)
break_it.what_happens: The undated implied-current framing would silently return to the brief
break_it.how: DAOutcomes.tsx suppression paths; jest 'without window fields (defensive)' and 'without a data window' tests

break_it.scenario: Someone reintroduces 'last N years' arithmetic in the brief UI
break_it.how: static-claims guard in DAOutcomes.test.tsx greps component + page source and fails the suite

break_it.scenario: Refusal stats for an LGA whose window excludes all data (e.g. years_back shrunk below the frozen extent)
break_it.what_happens: total_determined is zero and a 0/0 rate would be fabricated
break_it.how: get_refusal_rate returns None (queried-empty) -> brief renders AUTHORITATIVE None, HIDE_WHEN_NULL keeps the row out

post_merge.manual_verify: No — sentences are pinned by golden jest tests; live layer currency re-verified 2026-07-06
